Built with: CSS JS

Patterns & TrailsATM

Ordered surfaces that move: a grid of dots, the contour lines of a landscape, a line of light that follows the pointer. Without data-colors the pattern takes the theme's chart colors on the page background.

§Dot orbit

A dot per grid cell circles its center at its own pace and breathes with a wave that runs out from the middle; dots near the pointer grow with data-interactive. The grid is measured in CSS pixels, so it stays crisp at any size.

§A breathing grid

Move the pointer over it. The controls beside it are generated from the effect: its lists, its parameters and its colors.

×%
data-spacingThe grid in CSS pixels (26)data-sizeThe dots' size, 0-1 of a cell (0.5)data-orbitHow far they circle (0.4)

§Topography

A landscape of noise drawn as a contour map: lines at every height step, every fifth one heavier, the slopes hillshaded from the north-west and tinted by height. With data-interactive the pointer raises a hill.

§A contour map

Move the pointer over it. The controls beside it are generated from the effect: its lists, its parameters and its colors.

×%
data-linesContour lines per unit of height (12)data-thicknessTheir width in CSS pixels (1)data-zoomThe scale of the landscape (1)data-reliefThe hillshading (0.8)

§Trails

A line of light follows the pointer and fades, drifting like smoke as it goes; its color runs through the palette. Without a pointer it draws a figure of its own. The trail lives in a texture that each frame reads, fades and draws into again.

§A line of light

Move the pointer over it. The controls beside it are generated from the effect: its lists, its parameters and its colors.

×%
data-decayHow much of the trail each frame keeps (0.978)data-brushThe width of the line (1)data-flowHow much it drifts (1)

§Stained glass

A Voronoi diagram: every cell is the region closest to one moving point, its glass a color of the palette, lit brighter at its center. The lead between the cells is the true distance to the cell's border - measured along the bisectors with every neighbor - so it keeps one width all around.

§Cells of colored glass

The controls beside it are generated from the effect: its lists, its parameters and its colors.

×%
data-scaleCells across the height (5)data-leadThe width of the lead (0.06)data-glowThe light at the center of each cell (0.6)

§Halftone

A print screen: the picture is sampled once per cell of a rotated grid and drawn as a dot whose area grows with the darkness - the way a newspaper prints a photo. The grid is measured in CSS pixels. Without a picture it screens a moving pattern of its own.

§A photo as dots

The controls beside it are generated from the effect: its lists, its parameters and its colors.

×%
data-cellThe screen's cell in CSS pixels (8)data-angleThe screen's angle in degrees (15)data-contrastThe contrast of the tones (1.2)

§Kaleidoscope

The plane folded into mirrored wedges around the center, turning slowly, over a flowing noise in the palette - or over a picture child, mirrored at its edges.

§Mirrored wedges

The controls beside it are generated from the effect: its lists, its parameters and its colors.

×%
data-segmentsThe number of wedges (8)data-zoomThe scale (1)data-twistHow fast the picture turns inside the wedges (1)

§Matrix

Columns of glyphs fall at their own speeds: a bright head, a trail that fades behind it and the glyphs changing as it passes. Each glyph is a 5 x 7 grid drawn in the shader and mirrored so it reads like a character; the grid is measured in CSS pixels, so data-size is the glyph height.

§Digital rain

The controls beside it are generated from the effect: its lists, its parameters and its colors.

×%
data-sizeThe glyph height in px (16)data-rainHow fast the columns fall (1)data-trailHow long the trails are, 0-1 (0.6)

§Op art

Two sets of rings around two moving centers, combined as an exclusive or - the moire is where they disagree. Every edge is smoothed to the pixel, and where the rings get finer than a pixel they fade to gray instead of breaking into noise. Without data-colors it uses the theme's foreground and background.

§A moire

The controls beside it are generated from the effect: its lists, its parameters and its colors.

×%
data-ringsHow many rings per unit (18)data-offsetHow far apart the centers move (0.5)data-warpHow much the rings wobble (0.3)

§Glitch

A picture that glitches in bursts: blocks slide sideways, lines jitter, the color channels split and a block now and then inverts - and most moments it is clean. The picture is the element's img; without one it glitches a test card of the palette.

§A broken signal

The controls beside it are generated from the effect: its lists, its parameters and its colors.

×%
data-amountHow often and how hard it glitches, 0-1 (0.7)data-blocksHow small the sliding blocks are, 0-1 (0.5)data-shiftHow far the color channels split (1)

§CRT

A picture on a curved tube: the screen bends at its edges, scanlines run across it (never finer than two device pixels, so they cannot alias), a red-green-blue aperture grid and a soft bloom brighten it, and a band rolls slowly down. Without a picture it shows color bars.

The controls beside it are generated from the effect: its lists, its parameters and its colors.

data-curveHow much the screen bends (0.6)data-scanlinesThe scanlines per screen height (240)data-glowThe bloom (0.6)

/* -- Shader ------------------------------------------------------------------
   A WebGL2 effect inside or behind an element. The runtime adds a 2D canvas
   (.shader-canvas) the shared WebGL2 context copies each frame into; until
   the first frame - and wherever WebGL2 is missing - the element shows its
   poster: a static gradient of the same palette (--shader-poster).
   Variants: block (default, 16 / 9 or its picture's size), background (fills
   its parent behind the content) and border (a glow around its parent). */
@layer components {
  .shader {
    --shader-aspect: 16 / 9;
    --shader-glow: 1.25rem;
    --shader-poster-default:
      radial-gradient(120% 90% at 15% 20%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--chart-1) 75%, transparent), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(100% 80% at 85% 25%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--chart-3) 70%, transparent), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(110% 90% at 50% 100%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--chart-5) 65%, transparent), transparent 65%),
      var(--muted);
    position: relative;
    display: block;
    overflow: hidden;
    aspect-ratio: var(--shader-aspect);
    background: var(--shader-poster, var(--shader-poster-default));
    background-size: cover;
    &[hidden] {
      display: none;
    }
    & > .shader-canvas {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 0.6s ease;
    }
    &[data-ready]:not([data-fallback]) > .shader-canvas {
      opacity: 1;
    }
    &[data-fallback] > .shader-canvas {
      display: none;
    }
    /* the picture an effect reads: it sizes the box, stays for assistive technology, and gives way to the canvas */
    &:has(> img, > svg, > video) {
      aspect-ratio: auto;
      background: none;
    }
    & > :is(img, svg, video) {
      display: block;
      max-width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      transition: opacity 0.6s ease;
    }
    /* an inline SVG has no width of its own: it takes the box's, and the box takes the room it is given */
    &:has(> svg) {
      inline-size: 100%;
      & > svg {
        width: 100%;
      }
    }
    &[data-ready]:not([data-fallback], [data-image="blocked"]) > :is(img, svg, video) {
      opacity: 0;
    }
    & > script {
      display: none;
    }
    /* the posters of the effects with their own palettes - close to their first frame */
    &[data-effect="warp"] {
      --shader-poster-default:
        radial-gradient(90% 80% at 30% 40%, #e0548c, transparent 70%),
        radial-gradient(80% 70% at 75% 70%, #ffb36b, transparent 70%), #2a1a5e;
    }
    &:is(
      [data-effect="neuro-noise"],
      [data-effect="god-rays"],
      [data-effect="aurora"],
      [data-effect="galaxy"],
      [data-effect="orb"],
      [data-effect="fluid"],
      [data-effect="trails"]
    ) {
      --shader-poster-default:
        radial-gradient(70% 60% at 50% 45%, color-mix(in oklch, #7a6cff 35%, transparent), transparent 70%), #06070f;
    }
    &[data-effect="hologram"] {
      --shader-poster-default: linear-gradient(115deg, #ff8fd8, #8fe3ff 35%, #b7ffcf 55%, #fff3a0 75%, #c9a8ff);
    }
    &:is([data-effect="liquid-metal"], [data-effect="pulsing-border"]) {
      --shader-poster-default: none;
    }
    &[data-effect="water"] {
      --shader-poster-default: linear-gradient(#18a0b4, #0a4d68);
    }
    &[data-effect="fluted-glass"] {
      --shader-poster-default:
        repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18) 0 2px, transparent 2px 7.14%),
        linear-gradient(120deg, #ff5f6d, #ffc371 40%, #47cacc 70%, #5b5bd6);
    }
    &[data-effect="waves"] {
      --shader-poster-default: linear-gradient(#35548a, #f6c49c 48%, #0f7d8c 52%, #03253a);
    }
    &:is([data-effect="dot-orbit"], [data-effect="topography"], [data-effect="metaballs"], [data-effect="dithering"]) {
      --shader-poster-default: var(--background);
    }
    &[data-effect="plasma"] {
      --shader-poster-default:
        radial-gradient(70% 80% at 40% 30%, #ff006e, transparent 70%),
        radial-gradient(80% 80% at 80% 70%, #3a86ff, transparent 70%), #fb5607;
    }
    &:is([data-effect="bokeh"], [data-effect="starfield"]) {
      --shader-poster-default:
        radial-gradient(60% 60% at 50% 50%, color-mix(in oklch, #9b8cff 18%, transparent), transparent 70%), #07070f;
    }
    &[data-effect="ripple"] {
      --shader-poster-default: linear-gradient(#3fb8c7, #0d5c75);
    }
    &[data-effect="voronoi"] {
      --shader-poster-default: conic-gradient(from 30deg, #d1495b, #edae49, #00798c, #30638e, #7f5a83, #d1495b);
    }
    &[data-effect="clouds"] {
      --shader-poster-default: linear-gradient(#2f6fc4, #a9d1f5);
    }
    &[data-effect="fire"] {
      --shader-poster-default: linear-gradient(#0a0505 35%, #b3160b 70%, #ffb21f);
    }
    &[data-effect="silk"] {
      --shader-poster-default: linear-gradient(135deg, #2b0f3a, #7a2e8e 45%, #e07bb5 75%, #ffe3f1);
    }
    &[data-effect="nebula"] {
      --shader-poster-default: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 45%, #f72585 0, #3a0ca3 35%, #05030d 75%);
    }
    &[data-effect="prism"] {
      --shader-poster-default: linear-gradient(
        170deg,
        #0b0b12 40%,
        #ff5f5f 46%,
        #ffd25f 48%,
        #5fff8a 50%,
        #5fc8ff 52%,
        #a05fff 54%,
        #0b0b12 60%
      );
    }
    &[data-effect="matrix"] {
      --shader-poster-default: linear-gradient(#020a04, #0b3d1a);
    }
    &[data-effect="marble"] {
      --shader-poster-default: linear-gradient(120deg, #f4f1ec, #d9d4cc 60%, #f4f1ec);
    }
    &[data-effect="oil"] {
      --shader-poster-default: linear-gradient(120deg, #0a0a0f, #3b2a5c 40%, #1f5c5a 60%, #1d1b2a);
    }
    &[data-effect="op-art"] {
      --shader-poster-default: repeating-radial-gradient(circle, var(--foreground) 0 6px, var(--background) 6px 12px);
    }
    &:is([data-effect="lightning"], [data-effect="crt"]) {
      --shader-poster-default: linear-gradient(#070914, #141a33);
    }
    &[data-effect="snow"] {
      --shader-poster-default: linear-gradient(#6c8ead, #1b2a41);
    }
    &[data-effect="fireflies"] {
      --shader-poster-default: linear-gradient(#0b2e22, #03140d);
    }
    &[data-effect="glitch"] {
      --shader-poster-default: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff2e63, #08d9d6, #252a34, #eaeaea);
    }
    &[data-effect="caustics"] {
      --shader-poster-default: linear-gradient(#20a4c4, #0b4f6c);
    }
    &[data-effect="smoke"] {
      --shader-poster-default: linear-gradient(#26262e, #101014);
    }
    /* behind the content of its parent: the parent becomes the positioning and stacking context */
    &[data-variant="background"] {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: -1;
      aspect-ratio: auto;
      border-radius: inherit;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    /* a glow around its parent: the box reaches --shader-glow past the parent's edges, the inside stays clear */
    &[data-variant="border"] {
      --shader-poster-default: none;
      position: absolute;
      inset: calc(-1 * var(--shader-glow));
      z-index: -1;
      overflow: visible;
      aspect-ratio: auto;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
  }
  /* outside controls, generated from the effect: a list between a previous and a next button, sliders, colors */
  .shader-controls {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    align-content: start;
    min-inline-size: 0;
    & .shader-controls-field {
      display: grid;
      gap: 0.375rem;
      min-inline-size: 0;
    }
    & .shader-controls-head {
      display: flex;
      align-items: baseline;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    & .slider-value {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }
    & .shader-controls-cycle {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
      gap: 0.25rem;
      align-items: center;
      & .select {
        inline-size: 100%;
        min-inline-size: 0;
      }
    }
    & .shader-controls-colors {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.375rem;
      & input[type="color"] {
        inline-size: 2rem;
        block-size: 2rem;
        padding: 0.125rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--input);
        border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
        background: var(--background);
        cursor: pointer;
        &:focus-visible {
          outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
          outline-offset: 2px;
        }
      }
    }
    & .shader-controls-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }
  }
  :where(:has(> .shader:is([data-variant="background"], [data-variant="border"]))) {
    position: relative;
    isolation: isolate;
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .shader > .shader-canvas,
    .shader > :is(img, svg, video) {
      transition: none;
    }
  }
  /* more contrast: no moving picture behind text */
  @media (prefers-contrast: more) {
    .shader[data-variant="background"] {
      display: none;
    }
  }
  @media (forced-colors: active) {
    .shader {
      background: Canvas;
      & > .shader-canvas {
        display: none;
      }
      & > :is(img, svg, video) {
        opacity: 1;
      }
      &:is([data-variant="background"], [data-variant="border"]) {
        display: none;
      }
    }
  }
}

§JS view file

// -- Shader -----------------------------------------------------
// Animated WebGL2 effects - gradients, light, liquid, patterns and small 3D
// scenes - inside or behind any element. ONE WebGL2 context per page draws
// every instance and copies its frame into the instance's own 2D canvas: a
// page of twenty effects never meets the browser's context limit, a program
// compiles once per page, and each instance stays an ordinary box in the
// layout (clipped, masked, stacked, rounded like any element). Instances draw
// only near the viewport and while the tab shows, hold one still frame under
// reduced motion, and keep their CSS poster where WebGL2 is missing. Every
// shader here is written for this system (no third-party shader code). Plus
// the named-state API (AGENTS.md "State API").
// Shared preamble (AGENTS.md "State API"); the implementation lives in core.js -
// build.ts rewrites this import into a df$.shadcn.shared binding in dist/.
import { defussGlobals, defussQuery, componentState, bindComponent } from '../../../shared/state-api.js';
const df$ = defussGlobals();
const dfDollar = defussQuery();
// VERIFIED: (verify's component types ratchet - tsc -p tsconfig.components.json) every type
// this file's API docs state - arguments, return values, event details - holds against its code.
/** What shader-ready carries. */
interface ShaderReadyDetail {
  /** the effect on the canvas */
  effect: string;
  /** the canvas width in device pixels */
  width: number;
  /** the canvas height in device pixels */
  height: number;
  /** device pixels per CSS pixel the effect renders at (quality and the adaptive scale) */
  pixelRatio: number;
}
/** What shader-error carries. */
interface ShaderErrorDetail {
  /** the effect that cannot run */
  effect: string;
  /** why: no WebGL2, an unknown effect, a GLSL compile or link error (the driver's log) */
  message: string;
}
/** An effect: a fragment shader and its defaults - df$.shadcn.shader.register() adds one. */
export interface ShaderEffect {
  /** GLSL ES 3.00 - the body after the prelude (its uniforms and helpers come first), or a whole shader starting with #version */
  fragment: string;

// GLSL - the prelude every effect starts with: the uniform contract, noise,

const VERTEX = `#version 300 es
in vec2 a_position;
out vec2 v_uv;
void main() { v_uv = a_position * .5 + .5; gl_Position = vec4(a_position, 0., 1.); }`;
const PRELUDE = `#version 300 es

uniform vec2 u_resolution;
uniform float u_time;
uniform float u_delta;
uniform vec2 u_pointer;
uniform float u_hover;
uniform vec3 u_colors[8];
uniform int u_color_count;
uniform vec4 u_background;
uniform sampler2D u_image;
uniform float u_has_image;
uniform float u_seed;
uniform float u_pixel_ratio;
uniform vec2 u_frame;
uniform vec3 u_taps[8];
uniform int u_tap_count;
uniform float u_temporal;
in vec2 v_uv;
out vec4 fragColor;
#define PI 3.14159265
#define TAU 6.28318531
uint ihash(uint x) { x ^= x >> 16; x *= 0x7feb352du; x ^= x >> 15; x *= 0x846ca68bu; x ^= x >> 16; return x; }
uint cellHash(vec2 p) { uvec2 q = uvec2(ivec2(floor(p))); return ihash(q.x + ihash(q.y + ihash(uint(u_seed) + 7u))); }
float hash12(vec2 p) { return float(cellHash(p)) / 4294967295.; }
vec2 hash22(vec2 p) { uint h = cellHash(p); return vec2(float(h), float(ihash(h))) / 4294967295.; }
vec3 hash33(vec3 p) {

  return vec3(float(h), float(h2), float(ihash(h2))) / 4294967295.;
}
float gnoise(vec2 p) {

  float a = dot(hash22(i) * 2. - 1., f);
  float b = dot(hash22(i + vec2(1., 0.)) * 2. - 1., f - vec2(1., 0.));
  float c = dot(hash22(i + vec2(0., 1.)) * 2. - 1., f - vec2(0., 1.));

  float n010 = dot(hash33(i + vec3(0., 1., 0.)) * 2. - 1., f - vec3(0., 1., 0.));
  float n110 = dot(hash33(i + vec3(1., 1., 0.)) * 2. - 1., f - vec3(1., 1., 0.));
  float n001 = dot(hash33(i + vec3(0., 0., 1.)) * 2. - 1., f - vec3(0., 0., 1.));
  float n101 = dot(hash33(i + vec3(1., 0., 1.)) * 2. - 1., f - vec3(1., 0., 1.));
  float n011 = dot(hash33(i + vec3(0., 1., 1.)) * 2. - 1., f - vec3(0., 1., 1.));

  } else if (id == 7) { // herringbone: 2 x 1 bricks on a staircase, turned 45 degrees
    vec2 r = rot(PI * .25) * p * 1.41421356;
    float n0 = floor((r.x - r.y + 1.) * .25);
    d = 1e5;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      float n = n0 - float(i);
      vec2 s = r - n * vec2(2., -2.);
      float k = floor(s.y);
      if (s.x >= k && s.x < k + 2.) {
        float dd = sdRoundBox(s - vec2(k + 1., k + .5), vec2(1. - L * 1.414, .5 - L * 1.414), .05);
        if (dd < d) { d = dd; cell = vec2(n * 7. + k, k); cls = 0.; }
      }
      float k2 = floor(s.x) - 2.;
      if (s.y >= k2 - 1. && s.y < k2 + 1.) {
        float dd = sdRoundBox(s - vec2(k2 + 2.5, k2), vec2(.5 - L * 1.414, 1. - L * 1.414), .05);
        if (dd < d) { d = dd; cell = vec2(n * 7. + k2, k2 + 50.); cls = 1.; }
      }
    }
    d /= 1.41421356;
  } else if (id == 8) { // weave: three strands per cell, crossing in turn
    vec2 c = floor(p), f = fract(p);
    float horiz = mod(c.x + c.y, 2.);
    vec2 g = horiz > .5 ? f : f.yx;
    float strand = floor(g.y * 3.);
    d = max((abs(fract(g.y * 3.) - .5) - .5) / 3. + L * .6, abs(g.x - .5) - .5 + L * .4);
    cell = c * 3. + vec2(strand, 0.);
    cls = horiz;
  } else if (id == 9) { // scales: rows of discs, each row over the one before it
    d = 1e5;
    float j0 = floor(p.y * 2.);
    for (int k = -1; k <= 1; k++) {
      float j = j0 + float(k);
      float x0 = .5 * mod(j, 2.);
      float i = floor(p.x - x0 + .5);
      float dd = length(p - vec2(i + x0, j * .5)) - .62;
      if (dd < 0.) { d = dd + L * 1.2; cell = vec2(i * 2. + mod(j, 2.), j); }
      else if (d > 0.) d = min(d, dd);
    }
    cls = crand(cell, 9.) < .06 + u_variation * .6 ? 1. : 0.;
  } else if (id == 10) { // waves: ribbons on a sine
    float y = p.y + .22 * sin(p.x * TAU);
    float g = length(vec2(.22 * TAU * cos(p.x * TAU), 1.));
    d = (abs(fract(y) - .5) - .38 + L) / g;
    cell = vec2(0., floor(y));
    cls = mod(cell.y, 2.);
  } else if (id == 11) { // truchet: quarter arcs, every cell turned at random
    cell = floor(p);
    vec2 f = fract(p) - .5;
    if (crand(cell, 6.) > .5) f.x = -f.x;
    float a = abs(length(f - .5) - .5), b = abs(length(f + .5) - .5);
    d = min(a, b) - (.14 - L * .3);
    cls = crand(cell, 7.) < .1 + u_variation ? 1. : 0.;
  } else if (id == 12) { // maze: one diagonal per cell
    cell = floor(p);
    vec2 f = fract(p) - .5;
    if (crand(cell, 8.) > .5) f.x = -f.x;
    d = abs(f.x + f.y) * .70710678 - (.08 + L * .5);
  } else if (id == 13) { // cubes: every hexagon three rhombi - top, left, right
    vec4 h = hexTile(p);
    float a = atan(h.y, h.x);
    float deg = mod(degrees(a) + 360., 360.);
    cls = deg > 30. && deg <= 150. ? 0. : deg > 150. && deg <= 270. ? 1. : 2.;
    float e = min(.5 - hexDist(h.xy), min(rayDist(h.xy, PI / 6.), min(rayDist(h.xy, PI * 5. / 6.), rayDist(h.xy, PI * 1.5))));
    d = L * .6 - e;
    cell = h.zw * 3. + vec2(cls, 0.);
  } else if (id == 14) { // circuit: an edge is on or off for both cells it joins, so traces always meet
    cell = floor(p);
    vec2 f = fract(p) - .5;
    float eR = step(.55, crand(cell, 11.)), eL = step(.55, crand(cell - vec2(1., 0.), 11.));
    float eT = step(.55, crand(cell, 12.)), eB = step(.55, crand(cell - vec2(0., 1.), 12.));
    float tr = 1e5;
    if (eR > .5) tr = min(tr, sdSeg(f, vec2(0.), vec2(.5, 0.)));
    if (eL > .5) tr = min(tr, sdSeg(f, vec2(0.), vec2(-.5, 0.)));
    if (eT > .5) tr = min(tr, sdSeg(f, vec2(0.), vec2(0., .5)));
    if (eB > .5) tr = min(tr, sdSeg(f, vec2(0.), vec2(0., -.5)));
    float count = eR + eL + eT + eB;
    float pad = count == 1. ? length(f) - .17 : count == 0. ? length(f) - .07 : 1e5;
    tr -= L * .9;
    d = min(tr, pad);
    cls = pad < tr ? 1. : 0.;
  } else if (id == 15) { // topography: contour lines of a noise (periodic around a tunnel)
    float per = gPer > 0. ? gPer / 3. : 0.;
    float n = pnoise(p / 3., per) * .75 + pnoise(p / 1.5 + 9.1, per * 2.) * .3;
    float v = n * 5.;
    float rv = floor(v + .5);
    float major = step(abs(mod(rv, 4.)), .5);
    d = abs(v - rv) / 4.5 - L * (.45 + major * .55);
    cls = major;
    cell = vec2(0., rv);
  } else if (id == 16) { // stripes: bands in two colors, a groove between them
    cell = vec2(0., floor(p.y));
    d = abs(fract(p.y) - .5) - (.5 - L);
    cls = mod(cell.y, 2.);
  } else if (id == 17) { // chevron: the stripes folded into zigzags
    float y = p.y - abs(fract(p.x * .5) - .5) * 2.;
    cell = vec2(0., floor(y));
    d = (abs(fract(y) - .5) - (.5 - L)) * .70710678;
    cls = mod(cell.y, 2.);
  } else if (id == 18) { // circles: rings in every cell
    cell = floor(p);
    vec2 f = fract(p) - .5;
    float r = length(f) * 3.;
    d = max((abs(fract(r) - .5) - .5 + L * 3.) / 3., length(f) - .48);
    cls = mod(floor(r), 2.);
  } else if (id == 19) { // octagons with a small square between every four
    cell = floor(p);
    vec2 a = abs(fract(p) - .5);
    float r = .5 - L;
    float dOct = max(max(a.x, a.y), (a.x + a.y) * .70710678) - r;
    vec2 g = .5 - a;
    float dSq = (g.x + g.y) * .70710678 - ((1. - r * 1.41421356) * .70710678 - L * 1.5);
    if (dSq < dOct) { d = dSq; cls = 1.; cell = floor(p + .5) + vec2(0., 500.); }
    else { d = dOct; cls = 0.; }
  } else if (id == 20) { // stars: five points, every other row moved half a cell
    float row = floor(p.y);
    vec2 q = vec2(p.x + .5 * mod(row, 2.), p.y);
    cell = floor(q);
    vec2 f = fract(q) - .5;
    float seg = TAU / 5.;
    float m = abs(mod(atan(f.x, f.y) + 4. * TAU, seg) - seg * .5) / (seg * .5);
    d = (length(f) - mix(.17, .43 - L, m)) * .7;
    cls = crand(cell, 13.) < .1 + u_variation ? 1. : 0.;
  } else if (id == 21) { // stones: rounded cobbles
    vec3 v = voro(p, .8);
    d = L * 1.6 + .02 - v.x;
    cell = v.yz;
    cls = crand(cell, 14.) < .15 + u_variation ? 1. : 0.;
  } else if (id == 22) { // cells: the raised borders of an organic net
    vec3 v = voro(p, .9);
    d = v.x - L * .7;
    cell = v.yz;
  } else if (id == 23) { // glyphs: a 5 x 7 character in every cell, mirrored so it reads like one
    cell = floor(vec2(p.x, p.y / 1.4));
    vec2 q = (vec2(fract(p.x), fract(p.y / 1.4)) - vec2(.12, .08)) / vec2(.76, .84);
    vec2 gp = floor(q * vec2(5., 7.));
    vec2 pf = fract(q * vec2(5., 7.)) - .5;
    float px = max(abs(pf.x), abs(pf.y)) - .36;
    d = .1;
    if (q.x >= 0. && q.x < 1. && q.y >= 0. && q.y < 1. && crand(cell, 15. + min(gp.x, 4. - gp.x) + gp.y * 3.) > .5) d = px * .15;
    cls = crand(cell, 40.) < .08 + u_variation * .5 ? 1. : 0.;
  } else if (id == 24) { // crosses
    cell = floor(p);
    vec2 f = abs(fract(p) - .5);
    float arm = .13 - L * .3, len = .4 - L;
    d = min(max(f.x - len, f.y - arm), max(f.x - arm, f.y - len));
    cls = mod(cell.x + cell.y, 2.);
  } else { // lattice: a diagonal trellis, a stud at every crossing
    vec2 r = rot(PI * .25) * p * 1.41421356;
    vec2 g = abs(fract(r) - .5);
    float dl = (.5 - max(g.x, g.y)) / 1.41421356 - L * .7;
    float stud = length(fract(r + .5) - .5) / 1.41421356 - (L * 1.6 + .04);
    cell = floor(r + .5);
    if (stud < dl) { d = stud; cls = 1.; } else { d = dl; cls = 0.; }
  }
  return vec4(d, cls, cell);
}
float relief(float d, float bev, int mat) {
  float x = clamp(-d / bev, 0., 1.);
  return mat == 9 ? sqrt(clamp(-d / (bev * 2.6), 0., 1.)) : x * x * (3. - 2. * x);
}
// how much of a tile the raised shape covers, per pattern: the far, averaged color
const float COVER[26] = float[26](.8, .8, .25, .3, .8, .75, .85, .8, .75, .95, .65, .45, .35, .9, .3, .2, .85, .85, .6, .85, .35, .8, .3, .3, .35, .35);
bool isLine(int pid) { return pid == 2 || pid == 11 || pid == 12 || pid == 14 || pid == 15 || pid == 22 || pid == 25; }
// the light, the view and the camera's frame, shared by the materials
vec3 gV, gLd, gUp;
vec3 env(vec3 R, vec3 sc) {
  float ry = dot(R, gUp);
  vec3 e = ry > 0. ? mix(mixOk(sc, vec3(1.), .55), mixOk(sc, vec3(.04), .25), pow(ry, .6))
    : mix(vec3(.88), color(0) * .22, pow(-ry, .4));
  e += smoothstep(.05, 0., abs(ry - .02)) * .55;
  return e + pow(max(dot(R, gLd), 0.), 24.) * 1.2;
}
// a material at one point: m = how much of the raised shape covers it, d = the distance to its edge, nl = the
// relief's normal in the plane, Nw = the same in the world, detail = 0 for the far average (no fine texture)
vec3 shade(int mat, float m, float d, float aa, vec3 nl, vec3 Nw, vec3 sc, float face, vec2 p, vec2 cell, float shine, bool line, float detail) {
  vec3 V = gV, Ld = gLd;
  vec3 H = normalize(Ld + V);
  float diff = max(dot(Nw, Ld), 0.);
  float nh = max(dot(Nw, H), 0.);

    case 1: { // flat
      col = mix(c0, sc * face, m) + shine * .35 * m;
      break;
    }
    case 2: { // emboss: one color, the relief alone draws the pattern
      col = mixOk(c0, color(1), .12) * (.62 + .48 * diff) + spec * .12 + shine * .25;
      break;
    }
    case 3: { // neon: tubes along the lines and around the shapes
      float dl = line ? max(d, 0.) : abs(d);
      float core = (1. - smoothstep(0., .015 + aa * 2., dl)) * detail;
      float glow = exp(-dl * 14. / max(u_glow, .05));
      col = c0 * .07 + sc * glow * .85 * u_glow + mix(sc, vec3(1.), .65) * core + sc * shine * .5;
      break;
    }
    case 4: { // glass: tiles that bend what lies behind them
      vec2 off = nl.xy * .06;
      vec3 back = u_has_image > .5 ? image(v_uv + off).rgb : rampCycle(dot(p + off * 8., vec2(.05, .03)) + t * .02);
      vec3 inside = mix(back, sc, .3) * (.85 + .3 * diff) + spec * .9 + fres * .35;
      col = mix(mix(back * .5, c0, .5), inside, m) + shine * .3;
      break;
    }
    case 5: { // chrome: a mirror of a studio
      vec3 e = env(R, sc);
      col = mix(e * .42, e, m) * face + spec * .8 + shine * .6;
      break;
    }
    case 6: { // ceramic: glazed tiles in matte grout
      vec3 glaze = sc * face * (.45 + .6 * diff) + pow(nh, 160.) * 1.1 + fres * .2;
      vec3 grout = mixOk(c0, vec3(.9), .5) * (.8 + .2 * diff);
      col = mix(grout, glaze, m) + shine * .4 * m;
      break;
    }
    case 7: { // paper: a matte sheet, the pattern pressed and printed in
      vec3 paper = mixOk(c0, vec3(.95, .92, .85), .35) * (.84 + .22 * diff) * (1. + gnoise(p * 11.) * .04 * detail);
      col = mix(paper, paper * mix(vec3(1.), sc, .55), m * .85);
      break;
    }
    case 8: { // holo: thin-film colors that turn with the view
      float hue = dot(Nw, V) * 2.2 + dot(p, vec2(.05, .08)) + t * .08;
      vec3 rainbow = .55 + .45 * cos(TAU * (hue + vec3(0., .33, .67)));
      float sparkle = step(.985, hash12(floor(p * 14.) + floor(t * 6.))) * diff * detail;
      col = mix(mix(c0, rainbow, .25) * .8, mix(rainbow, sc, .25) * (.6 + .5 * diff) + spec * .7 + sparkle, m) + shine * .5;
      break;
    }
    case 9: { // quilted: padded cells, a stitched seam around each
      float stitch = (1. - smoothstep(0., aa * 2. + .01, abs(d + .056 * max(u_bevel, .02)))) * step(.5, fract((p.x + p.y) * 7.)) * detail;
      col = mix(c0 * .5, sc * face * (.4 + .7 * diff), m) + stitch * .35 * m;
      break;
    }
    case 10: { // metal: brushed steel, the grain along the tile
      vec3 base = mixOk(vec3(.74), sc, .22);
      float brush = gnoise(vec2(p.x * 1.5, p.y * 70.)) * detail;
      col = mix(c0 * .3 + base * .12, base * (env(R, base) * .55 + .22) * (1. + brush * .14) + spec * .5, m) + shine * .4 * m;
      break;
    }
    case 11: { // gold: a warm mirror
      vec3 gold = mixOk(vec3(1., .77, .32), sc, .12);
      col = mix(gold * .16, gold * (env(R, gold) * .7 + .12) + pow(nh, 90.) * gold * 1.2, m) + shine * .5 * m;
      break;
    }
    case 12: { // copper: a reddish mirror, a green patina in the grooves
      vec3 cu = mixOk(vec3(.93, .5, .34), sc, .1);
      vec3 patina = mixOk(vec3(.27, .62, .52), c0, .25) * (.55 + .45 * diff);
      col = mix(patina, cu * (env(R, cu) * .6 + .18) + pow(nh, 70.) * cu, m) + shine * .4 * m;
      break;
    }
    case 13: { // wood: rings across each tile, every tile cut its own way
      vec2 q = crand(cell, 41.) > .5 ? p.yx : p;
      float g = q.y * 6. + gnoise(q * vec2(.7, 4.) + cell * 3.1) * 1.4 + crand(cell, 42.) * 20.;
      float ring = mix(.5, smoothstep(.05, .45, abs(fract(g) - .5)), detail);
      vec3 light = mixOk(vec3(.8, .57, .34), sc, .14), dark = mixOk(vec3(.44, .25, .12), sc, .1);
      col = mix(dark * .4, mix(dark, light, ring) * (.55 + .55 * diff) + pow(nh, 70.) * .3, m);
      break;
    }
    case 14: { // marble: polished stone with veins
      float v = fbm(p * .45 + cell * .37, 4);
      float vein = (1. - smoothstep(0., .06 + aa * 4., abs(sin((p.x + p.y * .4) * 1.4 + v * 5.)))) * detail;
      vec3 stone = mixOk(mixOk(vec3(.95, .94, .92), sc, .1), mixOk(c0 * .3, sc, .25), vein * .75 + .1 * (1. - detail));
      col = mix(mixOk(vec3(.6), c0, .3), stone * (.72 + .33 * diff) + pow(nh, 120.) * .9 + fres * .15, m);
      break;
    }
    case 15: { // stone: rough and matte
      float n = (gnoise(p * 6.) * .5 + gnoise(p * 17.) * .25) * detail;
      vec3 base = mixOk(vec3(.56, .54, .5), sc, .25) * (.86 + n * .3);
      col = mix(c0 * .25 + base * .1, base * (.32 + .78 * diff), m);
      break;
    }
    case 16: { // rubber: dark and soft
      vec3 base = mixOk(vec3(.07), sc, .35);
      col = mix(c0 * .12, base * (.45 + .6 * diff) + pow(nh, 12.) * .1, m);
      break;
    }
    case 17: { // plastic: a clear color, a sharp white highlight
      col = mix(c0 * .6, sc * face * (.35 + .7 * diff) + pow(nh, 90.) * .9 + fres * .08, m) + shine * .4 * m;
      break;
    }
    case 18: { // velvet: dark facing you, bright at the grazing edges
      float rim = pow(1. - nv, 2.5);
      col = mix(c0 * .25, sc * (.22 + .32 * diff) + mixOk(sc, vec3(1.), .4) * rim * .85, m);
      break;
    }
    case 19: { // ice: cold, translucent, cracked
      vec3 ice = mixOk(vec3(.82, .93, 1.), sc, .2);
      float crack = (1. - smoothstep(0., .02 + aa * 2., abs(gnoise(p * 2.5 + cell * 1.7)))) * detail;
      col = mix(ice * .5, ice * (.62 + .3 * diff) - crack * .18 + spec * 1.1 + fres * .5, m);
      break;
    }
    case 20: { // lava: dark rock, the grooves glowing
      vec3 rock = mixOk(vec3(.12, .1, .1), c0, .1) * (.5 + .7 * diff) * (.85 + gnoise(p * 5.) * .2 * detail);
      vec3 hot = mix(vec3(1., .22, .02), vec3(1., .82, .3), .5 + .5 * sin(t * 1.5 + gnoise(p * .8) * 6.));
      col = mix(hot * u_glow, rock, m) + hot * exp(-abs(d) * 18.) * .45 * u_glow * m;
      break;
    }
    case 21: { // gem: faceted, a deep color, flashes of the spectrum
      vec3 disp = .5 + .5 * cos(TAU * (nv * 3. + vec3(0., .33, .67)));
      col = mix(c0 * .22, sc * .38 * (.5 + diff) + disp * fres * .7 + pow(nh, 200.) * 2.2, m);
      break;
    }
    case 22: { // pearl: soft white, a play of colors
      vec3 base = mixOk(vec3(.96, .94, .92), sc, .15);
      vec3 irid = .5 + .5 * cos(TAU * (nv * 1.5 + vec3(0., .33, .67)));
      col = mix(c0 * .5, base * (.55 + .45 * diff) + irid * .14 * (1. - nv) + pow(nh, 30.) * .35, m);
      break;
    }
    case 23: { // clay: matte, the light wrapping round
      vec3 base = mixOk(sc, vec3(.85, .6, .45), .25);
      float w = max((dot(Nw, Ld) + .5) / 1.5, 0.);
      col = mix(base * .45, base * (.28 + .75 * w), m);
      break;
    }
    case 24: { // toon: three tones and an ink outline
      float lv = diff > .6 ? 1. : diff > .25 ? .72 : .48;
      col = mix(c0, sc * face * lv + step(.97, nh) * .55, m);
      col = mix(col, vec3(.05), (1. - smoothstep(aa * 1.5, aa * 3. + .006, abs(d))) * detail);
      break;
    }
    case 25: { // glitter: flecks that twinkle
      vec2 g = floor(p * 22.);
      float fleck = step(.955, hash12(g + floor(t * 4. + hash12(g) * 4.))) * (.5 + .5 * diff) * detail;
      col = mix(c0 * .4, sc * (.4 + .6 * diff) + spec * .4 + fleck * 1.6, m) + shine * .4 * m;
      break;
    }
    case 26: { // wireframe: only the outlines and a fine mesh
      float edge = (1. - smoothstep(0., aa * 1.5 + .008, abs(d))) * detail;
      vec2 mg = abs(fract(p * 4. + .5) - .5) / 4.;
      float mesh = (1. - smoothstep(0., aa * 1.2 + .002, min(mg.x, mg.y))) * detail;
      col = c0 * .06 + sc * edge + sc * mesh * .2 * m + sc * .08 * m * (1. - detail);
      break;
    }
    case 27: { // x-ray: the slopes bright, the flat dim, on black
      vec3 bone = mixOk(vec3(.7, .9, 1.), sc, .2);
      float slope = length(nl.xy);
      col = vec3(.02, .04, .08) + bone * (m * .16 + slope * .9 + (1. - smoothstep(0., aa * 2. + .01, abs(d))) * .45 * detail);
      break;
    }
    default: { // bevel: raised tiles, lit
      vec3 tile = sc * face * (.3 + .8 * diff) + spec * .45 + shine * .4;
      col = mix(c0 * (.55 + .3 * smoothstep(0., .12, d)), tile, m);
    }
  }
  return col;
}
// the materials that glow on black
bool isDark(int mat) { return mat == 3 || mat == 20 || mat == 26 || mat == 27; }
void main() {
  gMotion = int(u_motion + .5);
  int proj = int(u_projection + .5), mat = int(u_material + .5), pid = int(u_pattern + .5);
  float t = u_time;
  float S = max(u_scale, .5);
  vec2 uv = centered();
  vec2 ptr = (u_pointer - .5) * vec2(aspect(), 1.);
  vec3 N = vec3(0., 0., 1.), T = vec3(1., 0., 0.), B = vec3(0., 1., 0.);
  vec3 rt = vec3(1., 0., 0.), up = vec3(0., 1., 0.), fw = vec3(0., 0., -1.), rd = fw;
  vec2 p;
  float dist = 0., sky = 0.;
  bool drift = gMotion == 0;
  // the drift's direction in the plane: on a flat surface 0 degrees is to the right; on a receding plane the
  // default (30) runs toward the viewer
  vec2 D = vec2(cos(radians(u_direction)), sin(radians(u_direction)));
  vec2 toward = rot(radians(u_direction - 30.)) * vec2(0., -1.);
  if (proj == 0 || proj == 7) {
    vec2 q = proj == 7 ? vec2(uv.x * .57735027 + uv.y, -uv.x * .57735027 + uv.y) : uv;
    p = rot(radians(u_rotation)) * q * S;
    rd = normalize(vec3(uv * .7, -1.));

    if (gMotion == 8) p += 2.5 * vec2(cos(t * .2), sin(t * .2));
  } else {

    float k = S * .25;
    float yaw = gMotion == 8 ? sin(t * .25) * .45 : 0.;
    float pitch = 0., fl = 1.1;
    vec3 ro = vec3(0.);
    bool spin = drift || gMotion == 5;
    if (proj == 1) { pitch = .7 + .5 * u_tilt; ro.y = 1.6; }
    else if (proj == 2) { pitch = .06 + .3 * u_tilt; ro.y = 1.; }
    else if (proj == 8) { pitch = -.06 - .3 * u_tilt; ro.y = -1.; }
    else if (proj == 3) { yaw += .3 + .5 * u_tilt; }
    else if (proj == 9) { pitch = .05 + .12 * u_tilt; ro.y = -.2; }
    else if (proj == 6 || proj == 10) { ro.z = 3.2; fl = 1.7; }
    else if (proj == 11) { pitch = -1.15 + .5 * u_tilt; fl = .8; }
    else if (proj == 12) { ro.z = 4.6; fl = 1.9; }
    if (drift && (proj == 4 || proj == 5 || proj == 9)) ro.z -= t * .9 / k;
    fw = vec3(sin(yaw) * cos(pitch), -sin(pitch), -cos(yaw) * cos(pitch));
    rt = normalize(vec3(cos(yaw), 0., sin(yaw)));

      if (drift) p += rot(radians(u_direction - 30.)) * vec2(1., 0.) * t * .9;

      float ty = abs(rd.y) > 1e-4 ? (sign(rd.y) - ro.y) / rd.y : 400.;

      h = ro + rd * tt;

      h = ro + rd * tt;
      vec3 s = normalize(h);
      if (spin) s.xz = rot(t * .2) * s.xz;

  vec2 rip = vec2(0.);
  if (gMotion == 5 && proj != 6 && proj != 10 && proj != 12) p = proj == 5 || proj == 11 ? p + vec2(t * .4, 0.) : rot(t * .08) * p;
  if (gMotion == 6) p += .3 * vec2(sin(p.y * .45 + t * .9), cos(p.x * .45 + t * .7));

  fragColor = vec4(dither(col), u_temporal > .5 ? hint : 1.);
}`,
  },
};
/** The defaults of a custom shader - an element's own <script type="x-shader/x-fragment">. */
const CUSTOM: Omit<ShaderEffect, 'fragment'> = { colors: THEME, background: 'var(--background)', still: 0 };

  advect: `uniform sampler2D u_velocity, u_source; uniform vec2 u_texel; uniform float u_dt, u_dissipation;
